scope: Unmodified EPC2302 model (LTspice, reltol 1e-6) against vendor-drawn typical curves. Model-to-datasheet consistency only; not a hardware measurement.
tolerance_timing: fixed after digitizing, before any model curve was compared (Fig. 7 separate)

Figure 4.assignment_rule: the 125 C curve has the higher RDS(on) at VGS = 5 V

Figure 5a.assignment_rule: CISS > COSS > CRSS at VDS = 100.0 V (largest VDS all curves reach)

Figure 5b.assignment_rule: CISS > COSS > CRSS at VDS = 100.0 V (largest VDS all curves reach)
